newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin names ex-journalist to run Kremlin staff.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin names ex-journalist to run Kremlin staff.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday named Valentin Yumashev, an aide who also helped him write his memoirs, to replace Anatoly Chubais as head of the Kremlin administration, Interfax news agency said.
The Kremlin press service could not immediately confirm the report. Yumashev, a career journalist, was appointed Yeltsin's aide in July 1996. He has helped Yeltsin write his two books.
